name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Carry the box to the exit' is correctly encoded as Existence(at_exit) plus Response(at_exit, holding_box), and 'whenever the box falls, pick it up again' as Response(box_fell, holding_box), all hard with no preference cues in the task. The machine reaches final state u3 only when the exit is reached with the box in hand and every fall has been followed by a pickup; box_fell is only a 'whenever' condition, so it needs no Existence, and no clause is redundant or added.

texts: Reach the exit at least once.
Whenever the agent is at the exit, the box must be in the agent's hands.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must hold the box again at some later point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3, u4
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u4
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u4, holding_box) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box, u2) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box, u4) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box, u4) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u2, box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u4, holding_box, u3) -> 11
